args.subject: Highlights from the art exhibition
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share a detail from the local art exhibition I attended last Friday. The abstract paintings really caught my eye, especially their vibrant colors and unique textures.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: A lovely gesture from last night's dinner
args.body: Hi Iris, I wanted to share a lovely gesture from our family dinner last night. My sister surprised our parents with a beautifully decorated cake she baked herself to celebrate their anniversary! It was such a heartwarming addition to the evening.

args.subject: Experience from the music festival
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I wanted to share a fun detail from the local music festival I attended last Sunday. Along with the live bands and great food, I also tried out a fun interactive art installation! It was a great experience.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Artisanal coffee at the farmer's market
args.body: Hi Henry, I wanted to share that I had a wonderful time at the farmer's market this morning. I particularly enjoyed savoring some delicious artisanal coffee from a local vendor. It was a great experience!

args.subject: Emma's Birthday Cake
args.body: Hi Alice, I wanted to share that I baked a delicious homemade cake for my cousin Emma's surprise birthday party last weekend!
